reason: Land the vendored Inter variable WOFF2 (rsms/inter v4.1, sha256 693b77d4...) on the trunk as a vendored binary asset. The per-task autoreview refuses binaries it cannot inspect; the font's integrity is proven by frontend/app/fonts/PROVENANCE.md + the font.test.ts SHA check, not by code review. Binary assets belong on the trunk (like the Pulse snapshot); landing it here lets the frontend-foundation review base advance past it so the review can run on the reviewable text diff.
